The Indonesian Navy found 405 tonnes of sodium perchlorate, a raw material for rocket propellants, aboard a ship it says was travelling from China to Bangladesh. That is more than seven years of Bangladesh's recorded imports of the wider chemical group. In this episode of , Bhaswar Kumar, ThePrint's Deputy Editor, Defence, looks at the mystery around the MV Star Line, its 59-day voyage and what remains unknown.
